title: tc-tray-status
description: A tray scene that says where something stands – all done, empty, an upload that failed, an import complete, an export ready, storage full, or a place to drop files.

count.description: How many new items "new-items" shows, in its badge and its words (default 3)

caption.description: The words under the drawing; unset, the status's own words; "" leaves them out

label.description: Accessible description, when it should say more than the words
